items.summary: CRO disposition: retain no new proposals, experiments, change requests, research requests, or queue work this cycle. Existing CEO/CTO/reviewer containment instructions supersede new CRO execution. Future evidence-backed opportunities remain backlog themes only: (1) affiliate conversion clarity on already-qualified sites; metric: affiliate outbound CTR and attributable orders; learn in 14 days or 100 new impressions; prototype: one reversible CTA/disclosure placement variant; risk: aggregate revenue cannot be assigned to sites. (2) Search-intent and above-fold clarity for pages with impressions but zero clicks; metric: organic CTR and sessions; learn in 14 days or 100 new impressions; prototype: one title/meta and heading variant; risk: avoid overlap with active measurement and preserve rollback. (3) Fleet measurement-state product capability distinguishing deployed, measurable, measured, proven, and unknown; metric: reduction in unmeasured deployed work and improved attribution completeness; learn after existing backlog reconciliation; prototype: read-only state mapping over current records; risk: no new telemetry or instrumentation. GitHub signals support research only: shadcn-ui/ui is MIT and passed bounded checks for accessible CTA primitives; microsoft/markitdown is MIT and passed bounded checks for document-to-markdown workflows; mermaid-js/mermaid is MIT but had no safe native checks. None has validated fleet security, maintenance, bundle, or revenue impact; prototype, security review, and owner-approved implementation remain required. Continue existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failure repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence work only. Preserve unknown revenue, ROI, margin, causal lift, cost-to-learn, budget exposure, and operational outcomes.
